# eBay UK

> eBay UK is a global online marketplace offering electronics, cars, fashion, collectibles, and auctions with secure account management and local shopping options.

eBay UK serves millions of buyers and sellers across the United Kingdom, providing a diverse range of product categories from consumer electronics and vehicles to collectibles like Pokémon cards and Warhammer merchandise. The platform emphasizes user security through identity verification, account authentication, and fraud prevention measures.

## Core Marketplace

- [eBay UK | Electronics, Cars, Fashion, Collectibles & More](https://www.ebay.co.uk): eBay UK marketplace homepage with electronics, cars, fashion, collectibles & auctions
- [Best Deals on eBay - Shop Electronics, Home, Beauty, Fashion & Toys](https://www.ebay.co.uk/deals): eBay deals page featuring discounted electronics, home, beauty & fashion items
- [local | eBay](https://www.ebay.co.uk/vlp/local): eBay local shopping with location-based pickup and postcode search
